summary: Macro Bank Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a cash dividend payment. The Board approved the third of three monthly equal, non-cumulative instalments of ARS 49,033,753,984.66 total, or ARS 76.6882980676 per share (7,668.8298% of outstanding capital). The record date is July 6, 2026, payable July 7, 2026 through Caja de Valores S.A. ADR holders will receive dividends via The Bank of New York Mellon. A 7% withholding applies under Argentina's Income Tax Law. This capital return follows CNV and Central Bank authorization. To watch: currency stability and ADR conversion mechanics.
